visual_name: Day in the life, part forty nine: the cake photo (low-poly 3D)
code_name: three.js barn wedding reception at golden hour (an open barn door onto a low sun, string lights sagging under the rafters, four round tables with cloths, flowers, candles and chairs, a flower arch, a dance floor, a three-tier cake on its own table, a cocktail table), box-built bridesmaid in a sage dress with an updo and her phone, the bride in a floor-length dress and veil, the groom in a navy suit with a mic, a photographer with a camera and flash, a bouquet on one world-space arc, a cake that squashes, icing on her face, phone sheets for the brand's last message / YourBrand notifications (bell with a badge, grouped Campaigns and Content, Content approved, a DM card) / her sister's framed photo, hard cuts on voiceover word times
summary: A 40.9 second 9:16 reel in low-poly 3D: a bridesmaid waiting on a brand's answer checks her email through her sister's vows, the speeches, the first dance and every photo. The bride throws the bouquet; she catches it with her face and falls into the cake. Then YourBrand: notifications, one bell, grouped by Campaigns and Content, Content approved, and a DM. It tells her, so she puts the phone face down and dances. Her sister framed the cake photo. It's in her hallway.
